build_rpn_head: build a StandardRPNHead module that predicts objectness logits and anchor deltas from feature maps
build_rpn: build an RPN module with configurable head, anchor generator, matcher, and box2box transform
label_and_sample_anchors: label anchors as positive/negative/ignore by matching them with ground truth instances using IoU
compute_rpn_losses: compute classification and localization losses for RPN predictions against ground truth labels
predict_proposals: decode predicted anchor deltas into proposals and select top candidates using NMS filtering
